subject: aerospace-materials-1
title: Aerospace Materials I — Assessment Test II (Midterm 2)
note: Assessment Test II of 22 November 2019 (model B) is Part I, a test of 10 questions with four options and one right answer (+0.5 right, -0.15 wrong, 0 blank, the mark never below 0; 5 points), and Part II, one problem of 5 points on a binary phase diagram. For 2026-27 Part II is two problems: a longer one on phase diagrams and a shorter one on Unit 5 (mechanical properties). The split 3 + 2 points follows the finals of 2016 and 2017, where the phase-diagram problem is worth 2 points and the Unit 5 problem 1 point. No paper prints a duration; 75 minutes is the standard here. The ten questions of the real paper are four on Unit 5 and two on each of Units 4, 6 and 7; the default scope keeps that mix.

content_scope_source: Units 4 to 7: phase diagrams, mechanical properties, electrical properties, magnetic and thermal properties (Sessions 7 to 13 and 15).

parts.label: Part I — Test
parts.description: Ten questions with four options and one right answer. Right +0.5, wrong -0.15, blank 0; the mark of the test is never below 0.

parts.label: Part II — Problem 1 · Phase diagrams
parts.description: The longer problem: a binary phase diagram (invariant reactions, lever rule, microconstituents, microstructure sketches, congruent melting, solubility) or the steels of the Fe-Fe3C diagram, with four or five parts.

parts.label: Part II — Problem 2 · Mechanical properties
parts.description: The shorter problem on Unit 5: a tensile test from data or a curve, or a bar under load (yielding, elongation and Poisson contraction, design with a safety factor, unloading), with two or three parts.

modes.label: Mixed (real paper)
modes.description: The mix of the real paper: 2 + 4 + 2 + 2 questions (Units 4, 5, 6, 7) and the two Part II problems (phase diagrams, 3 points; Unit 5, 2 points).

modes.label: Mixed (focus on Units 6 and 7)
modes.description: Weighted towards Units 6 and 7: 1 + 2 + 4 + 3 questions and the two Part II problems (phase diagrams, 3 points; Unit 5, 2 points).

modes.label: Unit 4 only
modes.description: Ten test questions on Unit 4 (Phase diagrams) from different blocks, graded out of 5. No Part II problem.

modes.label: Unit 5 only
modes.description: Ten test questions on Unit 5 (Mechanical properties) from different blocks, graded out of 5. No Part II problem.

modes.label: Unit 6 only
modes.description: Ten test questions on Unit 6 (Electrical properties) from different blocks, graded out of 5. No Part II problem.

modes.label: Unit 7 only
modes.description: Ten test questions on Unit 7 (Magnetic and thermal properties) from different blocks, graded out of 5. No Part II problem.
